scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Silvia is a personal financial assistant presented through a phone conversation about balances and investments.
explains_well: Follow-up questions move from total cash to account split, then from market news to one holding and portfolio risk.
unclear: No account dashboard or source is shown, so viewers cannot see how the answers connect to the underlying financial data.
scenario: Ask by phone about cash, market effects and portfolio concentration.
product_clear_basis: The captioned assistant reply supplies a specific cash balance after the presenter asks.

lessons.keep: Build the demo around connected follow-up questions rather than unrelated features.
lessons.avoid: Asking viewers to retain many financial figures without showing the underlying account view or a summary.
lessons.open: Account data, source accuracy, live-demo integrity, privacy claims, voice quality and actual latency remain unverified.
